message: About a week has passed since everyone gathered in the classroom and I began teaching them in earnest.

name: Iori
message: 「All right, everyone's present today too.」
I look around the classroom and confirm that all five of them are here.

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaah... I'm sleepy...」

name: Iori
message: 「Yep, yep. Momiji hasn't been late once since I asked Setsugekka to look after her.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, yes! That's all thanks to me, right, Sensei?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, it's all thanks to you, Setsugekka. Good job！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehehe, he praised me.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Nothing good about it. Secchan barges in every morning without even knocking. It's seriously beyond rude.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You don't wake up, so there's no point knocking. Would you rather I just wake you up with a punch from the start？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't resort to violence！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's Momimomi's own fault for not getting up right away！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You two have gotten a lot closer than before, haven't you?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？ How？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, you're calling her Secchan, aren't you?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Uh, that's just because 'Setsugekka' is long and hard to say.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Good grief, Momicchi's such a tsundere.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yep, she's a total tsundere.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm not! That's not my archetype!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, come on now, Momimomi just can't be honest with herself.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm gonna get mad, Setsugekka...！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I'm glad to see the two of you having so much fun.」
Watching Setsugekka and Momiji carry on noisily, Keisetsu smiles serenely.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, Keisetsu, teach Setsugekka some proper manners already!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I've done everything I possibly could. Please try to think of this as a vast improvement.」

name: Momiji
message: 「No way... and you’re saying this is an improvement...」
Momiji wears an expression of pure despair.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, harmony is a beautiful thing, after all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Momimomi and I are so close we could practically get married!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Absolutely not! She even spanked me again today!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s only because you were about to hit snooze for the second time!」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-yes！？ I’m sorry, I won’t do it again！」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ll permit a moderate amount of force. Keep it up.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay, I got Teacher’s stamp of approval! I’ll keep spanking you as much as I want now!」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s tyranny! An abuse of power! I demand your removal!」
Momiji grumbles, but this amount seems just right. Keisetsu, you don’t have to hold back your laughter, you know？

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, let’s get class started.」
Text fills the board right in front of us via HR.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... I don’t want to see any more text~」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu’s academic performance has been slowly improving lately. You need to hang in there.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But I’m stuck in remedial study every single day. Sitting and studying from morning till night is gonna make my body rot~」
Ririmu is slumped over her desk, looking exhausted.
It’s true that Ririmu has been spending quite a lot of time in remedial desk work. Now then, what should I do...

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, I’ll admit, doing the same thing over and over gets boring. How about we try a practice match for a change！」

name: Asahi
message: 「A match？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sounds good♪ Iorin, you get me~♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Then everyone, gather at the outdoor training grounds！」
Having a proper mutual sparring session here to get a sense of each other's abilities wouldn't be a bad idea.
